title.text:
Drawdown comparison, FULL SAMPLE (2000-01-03 to 2025-12-31): strategy vs buy-and-hold (XLI)
Full sample includes the GFC, which precedes the out-of-sample window. The -8.2% max drawdown quoted on the Strategy page is OOS-only (2020-01-01 onward); the deeper -19.3% trough here is Aug 2008. Different windows, not conflicting numbers.
